community.desc: Set up sticky messages, suggestions, the starboard and feeds

sticky.desc: Messages kept at the bottom of a channel
sticky.set: Set (or replace) the sticky message of a channel
sticky.message: The text to keep at the bottom
sticky.remove: Remove the sticky message of a channel

suggestions.channel: Set the suggestions channel (leave empty to turn suggestions off)

starboard.desc: Copy popular messages to a starboard channel
starboard.set: Turn the starboard on or change it

feed.desc: Post new YouTube videos or Twitch go-lives in a channel
feed.add: Follow a YouTube or Twitch channel
feed.source: YouTube: channel id (UC…) or /channel/ link. Twitch: login or twitch.tv link
feed.message: Message with {title} {url} {author} ({game} on Twitch); may mention a role
feed.remove: Stop following a YouTube or Twitch channel

cat.desc: The server cat, which grows as members chat
cat.view: See the server cat, its mood and how close it is to growing
cat.name: Rename the server cat (administrators)

tag.desc: Saved answers anyone can post, optionally sent automatically on a keyword
tag.name: Tag name
tag.triggerKind: Post this tag automatically when a message matches
tag.allowChannels: Only trigger in these channels (#mentions; "none" clears)
tag.denyChannels: Never trigger in these channels (#mentions; "none" clears)
tag.show: Post a tag in this channel
tag.newName: Short name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _
tag.edit: Change a tag (only the options you give)

suggest.desc: Suggest something for the server, or (admins) answer a suggestion
suggest.new: Post a suggestion members can vote on
suggest.status: Approve, deny or mark a suggestion as under consideration
suggest.reason: Shown on the suggestion and sent to the author

submit.description: Submit an application for a role
submit.application: The application you want to submit

status.description: Check the status of your application
status.id: Application ID (leave empty to see all)

list.description: List available applications to apply for

list.limit: Maximum number of applications to show (default: 10)

sticky.posted: It is now pinned to the bottom of {channel} and is reposted after members talk there (at most every 15 seconds).
sticky.notPosted: Saved, but I could not post in {channel}. Check that I can view the channel, send messages and embed links there.
sticky.listEmpty: None. Add one with `/community sticky set`.
sticky.empty: The sticky message cannot be empty.
sticky.tooLong: Sticky messages are limited to {max} characters.

suggestions.channelSet: Suggestions from `/suggest new` now go to {channel}. Make sure I can send messages and embeds there.

starboard.onLine: Messages with **{threshold}** {emoji} reactions are copied to {channel}.
starboard.rules: The author's own reaction and bots don't count; bot messages are never starred.
starboard.offDone: Starboard turned off. Existing starboard posts stay where they are.
starboard.emojiInvalid: Use one emoji: a standard one like ⭐ or a custom emoji from this server.

feed.twitchWatch: I will post in {channel} when **{author}** goes live on Twitch (checked every 2 minutes).
feed.liveNow: They are live right now: this stream is not announced, the next one will be.
feed.youtubeWatch: New videos from **{author}** will be posted in {channel} (checked every 15 minutes).
feed.noVideos: The channel has no videos yet.
feed.notFound: There is no feed #{id}. See `/community feed list`.
feed.listEmpty: None. Add one with `/community feed add`.
feed.youtubeIdInvalid: Give the YouTube channel id (starts with UC, 24 characters), or a youtube.com/channel/UC… link. @handles are not supported: open the channel, then Share → Copy channel ID.
feed.twitchLoginInvalid: Give the Twitch login (the name in twitch.tv/<name>), or a twitch.tv/<name> link.
feed.tooLong: The message is limited to {max} characters.
feed.twitchDuplicate: That Twitch channel is already posted to that Discord channel.
feed.youtubeDuplicate: That YouTube channel is already posted to that Discord channel.
feed.youtubeNoChannel: YouTube has no channel with that id.
feed.youtubeUnreachable: Could not reach YouTube to check that channel ({error}). Try again later.
feed.twitchOff: Twitch alerts are not set up on this bot yet.
feed.twitchUnreachable: Could not reach Twitch to check that channel ({error}). Try again later.
feed.twitchNoChannel: Twitch has no channel with that name.

tag.channelsUnreadable: Could not read any channels from {option}; mention them like #general, or write "none".
tag.notFound: There is no tag called **{name}**. See `/tag list`.
tag.textEmpty: The tag text cannot be empty.
tag.textTooLong: Tag text is limited to {max} characters.
tag.kindInvalid: trigger_kind must be none, word or regex.

tag.cooldownMin: Tags with a trigger need a cooldown of at least {seconds} seconds.
tag.nameInvalid: Tag names use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
tag.exists: There is already a tag called **{name}**. Use `/tag edit` to change it.
tag.nothingToChange: Give at least one thing to change.

cat.dbDown: The database is not responding right now, so the cat could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.
cat.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers and spaces for the name.
cat.notSaved: The database is not responding right now, so nothing was changed.
cat.renamed: The server cat is now called {name}.
cat.fullyGrown: Fully grown. This is the last stage.
cat.footer: The cat grows with every message members send here.
cat.grewText: Thanks to everyone who chats here. {name} is now a {stage} after {total} messages.

sentence.proud: {name} is proud: it grew a stage today.
sentence.happy: {name} is happy: the server was busier this week.
sentence.sleepy: {name} is sleepy: the server was quieter this week.

retention.info:
**Pending**: how long unanswered/in-progress applications are kept before being automatically removed.
**Reviewed**: how long approved or denied applications are kept.
-# Enter a whole number between 1 and 3650 (max 10 years).
retention.pendingInvalid: Pending retention must be a whole number between **1** and **3650** days.
retention.reviewedInvalid: Reviewed retention must be a whole number between **1** and **3650** days.
